# Mubar Store (https://mubarstore.com)
> Pakistan's Premier Destination for Luxury Homage & Contemporary Mechanical Timepieces.

Founded by Muhammad Mubashar in Lahore, Pakistan, Mubar Store provides affordable luxury timepieces with an uncompromising trust standard: **100% Open Parcel Inspection Before Payment** and **Free Nationwide Cash on Delivery (COD)**.

## Core Brand Values & Guarantees
- **100% Open Parcel Inspection:** Customers have the right to open the flyer in front of the courier rider, inspect the timepiece and its presentation packaging, and pay Cash on Delivery only upon total satisfaction.
- **Free Nationwide Cash on Delivery (COD):** Zero delivery charges to Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, and all nationwide locations.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 24–48 hours in Lahore; 2–4 business days across all major Pakistani cities.
- **7-Day Replacement Guarantee:** Full replacement warranty against manufacturing or transit defects.
- **Direct WhatsApp Concierge:** Fast customer care and order booking via +92 308 4453846.
